Prescriptions.listLede: Everything a clinician at {clinic} has prescribed for you, newest first. Only you and the staff at {clinic} involved in your care can read this.
Prescriptions.emptyBody: When a clinician at {clinic} writes you a prescription, it appears here — what to take, how much of it, and how to take it.
Prescriptions.unavailableTitle: Your prescriptions could not be loaded
Prescriptions.unreachable: Your records could not be reached just now. Try again in a moment, or call {clinic}.
Prescriptions.itemCount: {count, plural, =0 {No medicines listed} one {# medicine} other {# medicines}}
Prescriptions.cancelledBody: {clinic} cancelled it, so the pharmacy will not dispense against it. Do not start or change any medicine on the strength of this page — speak to {clinic} first.
Prescriptions.supersededBody: A newer prescription was written for you. Follow that one, not this. This copy stays here because your record is never rewritten — a correction is a new prescription, and both are kept.
Prescriptions.replacesNote: This prescription replaced an earlier one.
Prescriptions.attestation: The registration details above are what {clinic} recorded for this clinician, and they are shown here exactly as they were at the moment it was written. Carevelo has no access to Uganda's professional registers and has not checked them.
Prescriptions.itemsMissingBody: The list did not arrive with this prescription. Reload the page, and if it is still missing, ask {clinic} — do not assume the prescription is empty.
Prescriptions.controlledNote: A controlled medicine. It must be collected at the pharmacy, in person and with identification, and can never be delivered. There is no exception to this.
Prescriptions.immutableNote: A prescription cannot be edited once it has been written — not by the clinician, not by {clinic}, and not by Carevelo. If anything here is wrong, tell {clinic}: they cancel it and write a new one, and your record keeps both.
Prescriptions.documentBody: Open the written prescription as {clinic} issued it. The link works for five minutes and is meant only for you — it is not safe to forward, and it will have expired before it reaches anyone else.
Prescriptions.documentRenderingBody: {clinic}'s written copy is being produced. Wait a moment and press the button again.
Prescriptions.documentFailedTitle: That copy could not be opened
Prescriptions.documentFailedBody: Try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, ask {clinic} for a printed copy — everything you need to take your medicine is on this page already.
